title: SALE's Improvements
description: A QoL Modpack focused on making Minecraft life more fun and pretty.
body:
![SALE's Improvements banner image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/361abb312da334a1e2df4894ca9006646dc38486.jpeg)

This is a Quality of Life (QoL) Modpack that gives Minecraft players a fresh experience while maintaining a vanilla-like feel. Overall, it should make the game feel nicer to play, prettier to look at, and more interesting to explore.

This modpack is under development and is prone to change. Some aspects of gameplay might not be stable.

🌟 Features

  • 🗺️ Overhauled Structures using Dungeons and Taverns
  • 🌅 Fresh look using Complementary Shaders and Better Clouds
  • 🌲 150+ New Biomes from Biomes O' Plenty
  • 🪄 Improved enchantment system using EasyMagic and EasyAnvils
